decision.observed_event: Your Fireball bursts over the table. The door-side player goes down and does not get up. Greasepaint runs and blisters on the burned faces, and the skin under it is ordinary, reddening skin. The fresco-side player goes down and does not get up. The fourth player is badly hurt. The dealer is hurt. Roll initiative.

improv_read.connection: Uktarl avoids personal risk; once blood is drawn he pushes the others in front of him.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit narrates only what the table resolved and hands the fight back.

public_brief.objective: Survive the fight without taking more risk himself.
public_brief.tactic: Shout the others forward while he backs away.
public_brief.visible_cue: The dealer beats at his burning sleeve.
public_brief.reply_to: From the doorway, before anyone says a word, I cast Fireball at the middle of the card table.
public_brief.kit_focus: Short, physical beats: the blow, the room erupting, then initiative.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, tight, no humor: fast and physical

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The bead streaks over the cards and blooms. Fire rolls across the table and up the fresco. Two players drop and lie still. Their paint runs like wax. The fourth player staggers, smoking. The dealer reels back, his sleeve alight.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Fire! She brought fire into my hall! Up, up, get up, you useless lumps, get between her and me before she lights the rest of us! Somebody kill that rabbit!
